title: perf-benchmarking-sync-2026-07-07
content:
Perf & Benchmarking Sync - 2026-07-07
Attendees: Alex Chen (owner), Priya Rao, Miguel Alvarez, Samira Khan, Jordan Lee, several SREs

Summary:
- We observed a regression in hosted chat endpoint latency after the July infra roll (kernel + container runtime bump).
- P95 increased across ml-large-8x instances from ~110ms to ~180ms for short-chat workload (mean prompt 64 tokens).
- Throughput (tokens/sec) dropped ~18% on continuous-batching tests.
- Repro steps and initial triage performed; likely culprits: kernel scheduler change affecting CPU perf isolation, and a recent change to batching heuristic (max-batch-wait increased) in PR #482.

Metrics snapshot (baseline vs current):
- Baseline (2026-06-30 nightly): p50=42ms, p95=110ms, tokens/sec=18.6k
- Current (2026-07-06 Canary): p50=58ms, p95=180ms, tokens/sec=15.2k
- Error rate: unchanged (~0.2% 500s), KV cache hit-rate: -3% (likely unrelated but noted)

Test runs performed during triage:
1) Re-run benchmark with kernel pinned to previous image (linux-5.19-custom) on canary pool -> p95 drops back to ~115ms (suggests kernel change explanatory).
2) Revert batching heuristic PR #482 locally (set max-batch-wait=2ms instead of 10ms) -> tokens/sec improves to 17.8k, p95 reduces to ~125ms (mix effect).
3) Combined revert (kernel + batching revert) -> metrics close to baseline (p95 ~112ms, tokens/sec 18.1k)
4) Controlled A/B test (10% traffic to reverted config) in us-west -> no errors, user-observed latency improved on canary traffic

Root cause hypothesis:
- Primary: kernel upgrade introduced CPU scheduling latencies under high IO/interrupt scenarios; guest kernel configuration changed the CFS bandwidth/IRQ distribution and increased context switch costs for inference worker threads.
- Secondary: batching heuristic change increased per-request queuing latency for small prompts, amplifying kernel effect for p95 tail.

Action items (owners + ETA):
- Alex Chen: Open a rollback plan for kernel at infra level for next maintenance window. Blocker: need infra sign-off. ETA 2026-07-09. (Linked: JIRA PERF-1243)
- Priya Rao: Submit hotfix PR to revert batching heuristic (small change to max-batch-wait logging + metric). PR draft created -> target merge after quick smoke tests. ETA 2026-07-08. (Linked: PR #482)
- Miguel Alvarez & Samira Khan: Run extended nightly load (12h) over all instance types (ml-small/medium/large) with both reverted and current kernels to capture multi-tenant effects. Collect p50/p90/p95/p99, tokens/sec, KV hit, CPU steal. ETA 2026-07-10.
- Jordan Lee (SRE): Add kernel/irq metrics to perf dashboards and flag alert for p95 deviation >25% from baseline. ETA 2026-07-09.
- Samira Khan: Follow-up investigation into KV-cache hit-rate drop (could be unrelated) and check GC/eviction logs. ETA 2026-07-12.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Short term: revert batching heuristic immediately (hotfix) to recover majority of regression while infra investigates kernel rollout rollback.
- Mid term: engage infra team to validate kernel configuration differences and test patched kernel images in staging with perf harness.
- Longer term: implement a canary gating check that runs a quick perf microbenchmark post infra upgrades before full roll (automated gate + Slack alert). Owner: Miguel. ETA discussions next sync.

Notes / Observations:
- The regression is visible across dedicated and hosted environments but magnitude varies by instance family and tenant load patterns.
- Small-prompt workloads are disproportionately affected due to batching wait latency.
- No evidence of model-compiler or quantization regressions in this triage window; model artifacts unchanged.

Follow-ups for next sync (2026-07-14):
- Results from extended nightly runs (Miguel/Samira)
- Hotfix PR status and smoke test results (Priya)
- Infra rollback decision and staging kernel test plan (Alex + infra)
- Dashboard/alerts updated (Jordan)

Raw commands / quick notes (for engineers):
- benchmark harness: ./tools/perf_runner --model ml-large-8x --workload chat_short --duration 600 --concurrency 32 --report tokens_per_sec,p50,p95,p99
- kernel pin test image: image: redwood-kernel-5.19-custom:20260628
- batching revert local flag: MAX_BATCH_WAIT_MS=2

Context links (again): JIRA PERF-1243 (kernel rollback), JIRA PERF-1248 (batching investigation), PR #482 (batching heuristic change), Confluence investigation page.

End of notes.
